dropcontrol.title: DROP CONTROL
dropcontrol.subtitle: Select the drops you want to add or remove.
dropcontrol.base.label: REFERENCE DROP
dropcontrol.base.name: RULES
dropcontrol.list.title: DROP CONFIGURATION
dropcontrol.marker.witch_firework_rocket: Every witch hides a firework among her bottles, ready to propel her broomstick during a hasty escape beneath the moon above.
Adds exactly 1 Firework Rocket with flight duration 1 to 100% of witch drops.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.lore: Upon her nose, the witch bears her oldest mark; when she falls, the little wart still carries the damp scent of the swamp.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.descriptio: Adds exactly 1 Witch Wart to 100% of witch drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.
dropcontrol.marker.enderman_amethyst_sha: The energy bending space inside an enderman sometimes crystallizes, leaving amethyst still humming with echoes of the void.
Adds exactly 1 Amethyst Shard to 50% of enderman drops.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.lore: Pillagers hide tribute from distant villages, mixing emeralds, gold, and diamonds with memories of every ruthless past raid.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.descr: Adds exactly 2 items to pillager drops. Each item is rolled independently: a 50% chance of an Emerald, a 40% chance of a Gold Ingot, and a 10% chance of a Diamond. Both rolls may produce the same item.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.lore: Decay in certain zombies gathers a mineral stench beneath the flesh, forming sulfur where corruption has lingered too long.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.descrip: Adds exactly 1 sulfur to 30% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_poisonous_pota: Beneath forgotten soil, some zombies grow corrupted potatoes, steeped in the poison that still courses through their dead flesh.
Adds 1 to 2 poisonous potatoes to 35% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.lore: Weapons and armor held by bones without memory belong to the grave; when a skeleton falls, only what is truly its own remains.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.descri: Removes bows and any item with the EQUIPPABLE component from skeleton drops, including enchanted, damaged, or renamed items. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.lor: Pillager crossbows bear marks of many attacks, but their owners guard them to the end so no rival may inherit their violence.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.des: Removes crossbows from pillager drops, including enchanted, damaged, renamed, or loaded items. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.lore: Weapons and armor worn by rotten flesh and sulfur carry a stench that no sensible adventurer would ever willingly take along.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.descript: Removes any item with the EQUIPPABLE component, iron swords, iron spears, iron shovels, carrots, potatoes, baked potatoes, and iron ingots from zombie drops. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.lore: As she dies, the witch casts one last spell over her belongings, making everything vanish before curious hands can reach it.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.description: Removes every vanilla item drop from witches while preserving all rewards added by rules in the WITCH category.
dropcontrol.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
dropcontrol.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
dropcontrol.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
dropcontrol.options.aquatic_apocalypse.l: When rain falls, the dead forsake the land. The call of the waters raises them drowned to cover the world in a dark tide.
dropcontrol.options.aquatic_apocalypse.d: Replaces every zombie that would spawn naturally with a drowned while it is raining. Zombies created by other means are unaffected.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.lore: Raiders march without rest; each patrol clears the way for the next while their captains nurture ever darker and cruel omens.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.desc: Reduces the patrol interval from 12,000 to 800 ticks (10 minutes to 40 seconds) and its variation from 1,200 to 80 ticks (1 minute to 4 seconds), retaining all other vanilla spawning conditions. Doubles damage dealt directly by raiders. Captains outside raids that would already drop 1 Ominous Bottle instead drop 2, each with an independent Bad Omen level from I to V.
dropcontrol.options.parked_saddled_horse: An empty saddle promises patience. Trained to recognize their rider, mounts stand firmly wherever they were left behind.
Immobilizes mounts from the horse family while they are saddled and have no passenger. Normal movement returns when they receive a passenger or lose their saddle.
dropcontrol.options.rabbits_avoid_fences: After many interrupted escapes, rabbits learned to spot fences before leaping and seek paths where they can keep running free.

Prevents a rabbit from jumping when a fence in the vanilla #minecraft:fences tag is ahead of its movement, up to 1.35 blocks forward and 0.8 blocks to either side. The search covers a 5 × 5 block horizontal area and 2 vertical levels, from the current Y to the block below; detecting a fence cancels the jump and stops navigation.
dropcontrol.options.endermen_dont_pick_u: The world rejects the touch of endermen, binding each block to its roots and leaving their long hands empty before the landscape.
Prevents endermen from starting the action of picking up blocks from the world. Blocks already being carried remain with the enderman and can still be placed normally.
dropcontrol.options.chestplate_elytra_sw: Adventurers never choose between protection and freedom: with one motion, they stow armor and spread wings toward the horizon.

Switches between the equipped chestplate and an elytra from the inventory when Grave Accent, the key before 1, is pressed. If an elytra is equipped, it switches to a chestplate. When several items of the required type are available, it uses the one with the least remaining durability.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.lo: Experienced hands turn a journey's chaos into order, placing every treasure where it belongs before the next adventure begins.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.de: Sorts inventories only when Grave Accent, shared with GUARDED FREEDOM, is pressed. Requires Inventory Profiles Next. Outside interfaces or with the inventory open, it sorts the player's inventory. With a chest open, it sorts the chest first and then the player's inventory.
dropcontrol.options.pause_when_mouse_idl: When the adventurer steps away, the world holds its breath. Creatures, winds, and dangers wait silently for their return.
Opens the pause menu and stops the world after 15 seconds without mouse movement. Works only in singleplayer worlds that are not open to LAN and only while the Minecraft window is focused.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.l: Every coat tells a story, and experienced eyes recognize the mount's true essence through its markings and enduring vitality.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.d: Adds the horse's color, markings, and current and maximum health in health points to the Jade tooltip below its speed, rounded to two decimal places. The option can be configured without Jade, but the information only appears when Jade is installed.
dropcontrol.options.phantom_pressure_one: Each sleepless night strengthens the phantoms. They sense your open eyes and descend faster, drawn toward your growing weariness.

Reduces the time since last rest required for phantoms to begin spawning from 3 to 2 in-game days. Doubles the size of each generated group and increases phantom movement speed by 20% while preserving all other vanilla spawning conditions.
dropcontrol.options.phantom_pressure_two: Phantoms no longer fear the dawn, and every hungry dive tears through steel in search of those who stubbornly remain awake.

Triples bite damage, makes that damage completely ignore armor, increases the volume of phantom vocal sounds by 50%, and prevents phantoms from burning in daylight. Effects, enchantments, and all other damage reductions continue to work normally. A phantom that successfully bites a player has a 0% chance to drop a phantom membrane, even after the world is reloaded. Disabling this option kills all loaded living phantoms.
